summary: The construction, fiber masses, centerpoint localization, primitive-ray deficit calculation, strict failures of alternatives (A) and (B), covariance-core comparison, and subset depth bound all follow with the stated constants and quantifiers. Boundary cases at R=5, the upper and lower layer halfspaces, horizontal zero-deficit rays, and the two barycentric representations used to force the full-support core empty are handled correctly. The final conclusion distinguishes failure of the proposed anchor-choice route from a counterexample to the weak Oertel statement.
